title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11c — profile repository-root bridge
goal: Allow profile authorities to remain package-owned while generic V3 commands inspect a separate target repository.
acceptanceCriteria: Generic V3 Validate, Docs, Setup and Architecture resolve profile inputs beneath an explicit ProfileRepositoryRoot, defaulting to TargetRoot for compatibility.
Relative and absolute profile inputs cannot escape the declared profile repository root.
The IFX facade passes its package repository for Validate, Pre, Diff and candidate generation.
Generic tool tests and IFX target-root separation pass without changing gate verdicts or moving policy authorities.
